_about: Starter vocabulary for a consulting or transformation engagement. A FIRST DRAFT to edit. A relation is {domain, range, inverse, definition}. Use A|B for a union.
_summary: Engagements: scope, deliverables, governance, sessions, decisions and the work that follows.
name: Engagement Knowledge Base

Engagement.definition: A contracted body of work between a supplier and a client, with a scope and a period.

Organization.definition: A company or a unit within one: the client, the supplier, a division, a function.

Person.definition: A named individual. Consider carefully whether you need this class at all; see the README.

Role.definition: A defined function in the target operating model or the delivery team. Filled by a person.

Workstream.definition: One scope area of the engagement, with its own plan and owner.

Deliverable.definition: A contracted artifact with a due date and an acceptance condition.

GovernanceForum.definition: A recurring body that decides or validates: a steering committee, a working group, a review board.

Session.definition: A dated event that produced something: an interview, a workshop, a meeting. Distinct from the transcript recording it.

Decision.definition: A choice made, proposed or deferred, with its reason. Superseded by a later decision, never overwritten.

ActionItem.definition: A committed task arising from a session or a decision, with an owner and a state.

Question.definition: An open question raised and not yet answered, with an owner.

Concept.definition: A construct the engagement designs or adopts: an operating model element, a way of working, a capability.

Framework.definition: A reusable method or model brought to the engagement rather than invented in it.

Document.definition: A source document in the corpus: a contract, a deck, a transcript, a plan.

client_of.definition: The client an engagement is for.

scoped_as.definition: A workstream inside an engagement's scope.

produces.definition: What a workstream or session produced.

member_of.definition: Membership in an organization or forum.

instance_of.definition: A session that is one meeting of a recurring forum.

recorded_in.definition: The document that records a session.

raised.definition: An outcome that came out of a session.

discusses.definition: A subject a session or document covers.

implements.definition: An action item carrying out a decision.

informed_by.definition: A method or model relied on.

supersedes.definition: This replaced that. Use with the temporal fields, never by overwriting.
